notablePrerequisites: Vessel of the All-Consuming has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Vessel of the All-Consuming using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Vessel of the All-Consuming's first ability triggers, as well as its second ability if it has dealt 10 or more damage to the opponent this turn.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Vessel of the All-Consuming.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing the opponent to lose the game.
Repeat.

uses.name: Hidetsugu Consumes All // Vessel of the All-Consuming
